_comment: The CLI surface the stage table reads, and nothing else. Same design as the
regcf, sg-succession and chubb sidecars' pins: deliberately NOT a hash of
`l4 --help`, because any unrelated CLI change would fire a BROKEN verdict on
an otherwise fine run, and a tripwire that cries wolf gets deleted.
Recovered by probing: `export_formats` from the Formats: list of
`l4 export --help`, and checked as a SUBSET (the formats the phases run must
still be offered); the others from a deliberately-bad value whose error
lists the accepted set. See etc/go/lib/discover.mjs.
MEASURED 2026-09-16 with `node etc/go/lib/discover.mjs enums
jl4/examples/canon/il/ofek-hadash-2008/ofek-pay.l4`, against the prebuilt
binary at l4wt/every-land/dist-newstyle/build/aarch64-osx/ghc-9.10.3/jl4-0.1/
x/l4/build/l4/l4 (sha256 f1f34176db2b8ef6cb43e15a...), with
JL4_LIBRARY_PATH pointed at that worktree's jl4-core/libraries. The four
enumerations came back identical to the ones regcf pinned on 2026-08-02,
sg-succession on 2026-08-18 and chubb on 2026-08-31, which is the expected
result and is recorded rather than assumed.
`regulative_rules` IS DELIBERATELY EMPTY, and that is a fact about the
subject rather than a gap in the measurement. Ofek Hadash decides what a
teacher is PAID; it states no obligation. All nine modules are entirely
CONSTITUTIVE -- `grep -cE '\b(MUST|MAY|SHANT)\b'` returns 0 for each -- and
`l4 export jl4/examples/canon/il/ofek-hadash-2008/ofek-pay.l4 --to bpmn`
accordingly answers 'No regulative rules found in module', which discover.mjs
treats as a legitimate empty set rather than a shape change. p7-bpmn and
p7-lts are therefore not declared in subject.json; see its _comment.
`checkers_that_must_exist` IS EMPTY, and the reason is the opposite of
chubb's. None of this subject's declared legs (p7-akn, p7-mcp) shells out to
an etc/ checker, and no standing guard has been MEASURED for it either --
etc/check-not-precedence.mjs has not been run over these modules, so listing
it would be a prediction rather than a measurement. Add it, with the date and
the output, the first time it is actually run clean.
